title: Prepared variant-level regression input for the epilepsy unified meta-regression (corrected)
description:
Shared by private link, not published. This table is derived from Epi25 case and control allele counts. It is provided to named collaborators for reproduction of AJHG-D-24-00613 and is not for onward redistribution.

The prepared variant-level table that feeds the unified meta-regression, with both August 2026 corrections applied. It is the output of pipelines/01_build_regression_input.py at https://github.com/healthcare-medicine-ai/wgs-constraint-llm, branch gerp-am-corrections.

Contents. Tab-separated, gzipped, 9,620,584 rows, one per variant-gene-group. Columns:

  • chr, pos — GRCh38, 1-based; with ref and alt
  • gene_id, gene_name — GENCODE v44 basic annotation, protein-coding CDS
  • group — epilepsy subtype: DEE, EPI, GGE or NAFE
  • ac_case, an_case, ac_ctrl, an_ctrl — Epi25 allele counts and numbers
  • effect_size, var_effect_size — Haldane-Anscombe corrected log odds ratio and its Woolf variance, from the allele counts
  • prob_0 — HMM constrained-state probability
  • GERP_RS — GERP rejected substitutions, GRCh38
  • am_pathogenicity — AlphaMissense, collapsed to one row per variant by maximum
  • pLoF_ind, missense_ind — consequence indicators

Both corrections are applied. First, GERP is indexed 1-based. The submitted analysis read 1-based positions from a 0-based bigWig vector, which shifted every score one base downstream; corrected and shifted values correlate at only r = 0.17, because adjacent coding bases differ sharply in conservation. Second, AlphaMissense is collapsed to one row per variant. The submitted analysis merged the isoform-level release without de-duplication, so a variant annotated on N transcripts became N rows, inflating both the variant count per gene and its weight in the weighted least squares. Row inflation in this file is 1.0000.

Two analysis choices external reproductions have most often got wrong. The rare-variant cut is on allele count, ac_case + ac_ctrl ≤ 5, not on allele frequency; MAF ≤ 0.05 admits variants roughly three orders of magnitude more common. Effect sizes are computed from allele counts as above, so Firth BETA and SE are neither used nor required.

On bit-level reproduction. effect_size passes through np.log, and numpy dispatches a different SIMD kernel on AVX-512 than on AVX2. Rebuilding this table on an Intel Skylake-X machine reproduces it exactly; rebuilding on AMD Rome differs on about 18 percent of rows by up to 3.3e-15. No gene changes significance as a result. Expect agreement to about fifteen significant figures rather than byte equality unless the architecture matches.

File properties. gzipped TSV, 181,710,689 bytes. md5 of the compressed file bd6e909a1fce473fd31190b863df42bb. md5 of the decompressed stream 681f3a4c172e7432e7f4f0cebd5cfcad, built on Intel Skylake-X.

Inputs. Epi25 variant results; GENCODE v44 basic annotation, md5 7450ef42cf9cb3d29625320b22d4bb45; AlphaMissense hg38 isoform-level release; HMM constraint predictions, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.27184245; GERP RS for GRCh38, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.33201549.
